body_html:
#edu407 #edu305 #edu307 here is a tutorial on how to sign up for inoreader and add our class feeds to yoru account. Then if you download the phone app you can get the feeds updated.

Of course you can always book mark class feed page. https://archive.org/details/AddClassFeedstoRSSReader #Videotutorial
